claims.statement: Canadian joint regulator concluded aggregate Kogan-derived scores reached AIQ
claims.scope: original regulator finding, US SCL campaigning

severe_test.would_narrow: Original data-producer or privacy-regulator correction showing AIQ did not receive ANY Kogan-derived score material in the scoped US work would narrow the claimed lineage; denial of raw Facebook app access alone does not.
severe_test.would_strengthen: Regulator-authenticated non-personal derivation or distribution records tying specified GSR outputs to AIQ would strengthen specific lineage; no raw voters or outcome claim.

claims.statement: UK regulator reports actual AIQ campaign payments and distinct appeal outcomes

severe_test.would_narrow: Original amended UK Electoral Commission dispositions removing or correcting specific AIQ service payments, recipient classification or campaign return would narrow the asserted accounting; Grimes' successful appeal already limits the earlier sanction.
severe_test.would_strengthen: Original matching payment invoices, bank-origin refs and judicial appeal dispositions would strengthen transaction-level identification, not GSR/score-file content.

claims.statement: Original FTC v Bannon CID pleadings and DDC show-cause proceeding exist; no resolved personal wrongdoing inferred

severe_test.would_narrow: An original court record correcting docket identity or rescinding the described procedural hearing would narrow the procedural claim; Bannon's defence is already retained separately.
severe_test.would_strengthen: The signed court show-cause order, FTC petition/reply and independently authored Bannon response jointly establish adversarial procedure only; original final docket would resolve procedural outcome.

claims.statement: Final procedural disposition of the FTC civil investigative demand enforcement petition against Bannon
claims.scope: Original final court order or FTC withdrawal, not a merits adjudication of Bannon personal CA-data liability

severe_test.would_narrow: An original case closing/withdrawal order would narrow hypotheses of later compelled CID hearing; neither hypothetical route decides personal privacy liability.
severe_test.would_strengthen: Original final signed court order, authenticated dismissal/withdrawal or FTC docket disposition would settle what happened to the demand, without converting a hearing decision into personal guilt.

claims.statement: Final historical outcome of DEA OCDETF NY-NYS-0829
claims.scope: original signed or agency-authenticated final record

severe_test.would_narrow: Signed agency closure/declination or case-status record showing no charges or a different disposition would narrow hypotheses of prosecution or intervention; no original is inspected.
severe_test.would_strengthen: Authenticated original DEA/OCDETF NY-NYS-0829 final outcome naming the actual status would resolve the administrative outcome, not independently establish every allegation in the 2015 lead.

claims.statement: Exact original bank transaction classification in Black-to-Epstein 2016 ledger

severe_test.would_narrow: Bank-origin evidence that the 2016 USD difference reflects an asset, internal movement, unrelated recipient or another explicitly classified scope would narrow hidden-fee claims; total arithmetic alone does not discriminate.
severe_test.would_strengthen: Lawfully redacted originating bank wire and same-object accounting/invoice/legal classification would strengthen a particular transaction interpretation.

severe_test.would_narrow: An original joint case-ID/source record showing these are the exact same legal investigative operation would narrow the present distinct-case model; generic agency overlap or title cannot.
severe_test.would_strengthen: Original HSI contemporaneous anti-counterfeit agency records and DEA NY-NYS-0829 narcotics lead independently identifying agency/case purpose strengthen separation; DEA native scan still pending.

claims.statement: Signed 2019 producer agreement connects distinct original media work to a specific transfer
claims.scope: legal work/rights, not FTC cause or hidden programme

severe_test.would_narrow: Executed rights/producer agreements explicitly excluding a proposed service or identifying different legal production partners would narrow that contractual transfer; no missing contract implies absence.
severe_test.would_strengthen: Original dated signed 2019 media production/work-product/counterparty record, with actual work and payer identity, would support a narrow transaction only.

claims.statement: A specific GSR output version maps to named Ripon input/build

severe_test.would_narrow: Versioned original parser/build evidence showing disjoint model provenance or different campaign build would narrow a SPECIFIC claimed GSR score-to-Ripon row; no change to aggregate regulator finding.
severe_test.would_strengthen: Non-personal hashes, schema version, distribution and named build import proof from two original software custodians would strengthen exact lineage.
